hypothesis: Remove horizon-identity reward from shared LFQ diversity by conditioning entropy on horizon; retain the same independentQFormer H9 initial-only future reconstruction architecture and all other settings.

data.sampling: Shuffle all starts0..175 without replacement per epoch. Each window uses consecutive S_t through S_t+9. At the end repeat frame176; use nominal increasing temporal positions and explicitly flag padding. All9 targets participate in training as in reference boundary padding; padded targets excluded from metrics.

state_quantizer: None. Entire GaussianGPT encoder/decoder frozen; continuous sparse coordinates[M,3] and features[M,64].

qformer.prefix: Module h reads causal encoded spatial keys only from the SAME window initial state through target h inclusive. No shared posterior weights; no per-query self-attention. Reference cross-attention/MLP equations and final queries+queries preserved.
qformer.position: World-coordinate3D and relative PTS Fourier embeddings64, GS-specific additions; no absolute frame index.

causal_temporal.alignment: Integer world-coordinate union is indexing only; absent state features0 plus occupancy; unseen columns removed from prefix keys. No future-driven spatial pooling or truncation.
causal_temporal.decoder: For each initial-only candidate coordinate, concatenate initial spatial embedding at time0 and spatially broadcast quantized64 token at times1..9; causal temporalCNN jointly yields nine future64 features and occupancy logits. Initial interpolated feature residual at every horizon, initial occupancy prior +/-4. No true intermediate state.

motion_quantizer.joint_entropy_pool: One shared LFQ with9 horizon groups, each4 windows. Average9 already-weighted auxiliary losses; no diversity reward acrossh.
motion_quantizer.entropy_formula: 0.1*mean_h softplus(mean_b H(p_bh)-H(mean_b p_bh)+5). Applies softplus inside horizon mean.

condition: Only initial integer coordinates, continuous64 features, nominal dt and nine LFQ IDs; decoder candidate geometry comes from initial coordinates only. No targets supplied to decoder/support selection during training or evaluation.

support.rule: Reuse verified initial-only Chebyshev dilation radius6 and 4-neighbor interpolation. Preflight checks all9 target supports at all176 starts, stop if any missing. No truncation.

train.objective: Mean over batch4 and ALL9 future horizons, plus mean of9 conditional LFQ entropy losses once. Main render term is squared error to future real RGB; frozen-codec and pseudoview L2 are GS adapters. Feature MSE divided by each target feature mean square (clamped1); occupancy calibrated weightedBCE. Initial state is supplied unchanged, so no learned loss on x_t. This implements paper future-reconstruction semantics, not exact published GAN/L1 optimizer recipe.
train.gradient_staging: Encode B4 jointly. For each sequence use quantized leaf as gradient buffer; backprop9 future losses, sum exact code gradients, then vector-Jacobian product through original LFQ/encoder plus mean conditional auxiliary loss. One optimizer step after all36 targets. Verify direct-vs-staged gradients. No temporal gradient truncation.
train.checkpoint: Atomic latest every50 and final; optimizer/sampler/RNG and source hashes; exception snapshot marked resumable only after completed step; no automatic resume.

controls: hold window initial state at each target camera
artifacts: per-window and per-horizon metrics for1548 real targets
AR future-bundle IDs[1,176,9] and flattened[1,1584], with valid horizon mask
six-column176-target video at29.97fps, true initial reset once every9frames, not AR rollout
final-weight encoder and decoder causality report
evaluation.scope: Oracle posterior TRAIN reconstruction. Every target frame represented; repeated targets across overlapping windows counted explicitly. Padding excluded from scientific metrics. Report h1..h9 separately.

retries: No automatic retries, no scientific retuning, no point/frame/resolution reduction
limitations: Offline NeoVerse teacher uses whole video; conditional GS causality does not imply online video causality.
Posterior sees true future up to each horizon. No AR model trained in this run.
Single admitted TRAIN clip, not generalization evidence.
Frozen state codec fidelity gate already failed; engineering completion cannot establish full-model fidelity.
H9 IDs are future-horizon bundles tied to a common initial state; no claim of nine independent physical adjacent actions or semantic disentanglement.
64wide world-coordinate temporalConv1d, sparse support and residual are GS adapters; not identical pixelConv3d architecture.
Decoder uses strict causal per-time normalization; official VideoWorld decoder permits future quantized-token coupling through global normalization. This stricter GS decoder is intentional.
Future9 squared-error reconstruction follows paper objective semantics; released VideoWorld code also uses full10-frame L1 and sampled perceptual/GAN terms, not reproduced here.
Architecture, horizon, decoder and objectives change together; previous runs are contextual references, not isolated ablation.
B4 bounds empirical hard entropy inside each batch/horizon by ln4; removing horizon reward alone does not guarantee recovery or useful motion tokens. One fixed-budget single-variable comparison only.

comparison.only_scientific_change: LFQ auxiliary entropy grouping: mean_h softplus(E_b H(p_bh)-H(E_b p_bh)+5)*0.1; previous softplus pools b and h before marginal entropy. Same quantizer, forward codes, inverse, seed, sampler, optimizer, loss weights and750 updates.
comparison.initialize: Same initial seed and exact initial state_dict hash, NOT collapsed final checkpoint.
